name: na-pharma-root
description: N A Pharma — monorepo root. Orchestrates backend and frontend dev servers.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" --names "API,WEB" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:frontend --prefix na-pharma"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix na-pharma
